name: Warmaster Laggrond
summary: Outside Alterac Valley, Warmaster Laggrond prepares Horde fighters for the Frostwolf clan. He commands from the valley’s entrance in the Alterac Mountains, where warriors answer the call to aid the Frostwolves.

sections.title: Frontline Commander
sections.body: Warmaster Laggrond directs the Horde's fight against the Stormpike Expedition at Alterac Valley's entrance. In the bitter cold, he admits only capable fighters to represent the Frostwolf clan and the wider Horde.

sections.title: The Path of Honor
sections.body: Warmaster Laggrond sends arriving combatants through the Proving Grounds before they enter battle. As warriors fight across the frozen peaks, he measures their standing and honors those who earn renown among the Frostwolves.

faq.answer: Warmaster Laggrond is posted near the Horde encampment at Alterac Valley's entrance portal, in the snowy passes of the Alterac Mountains north of Hillsbrad Foothills.
Warmaster Laggrond recruits for the Horde's war in Alterac Valley. He tests new fighters and honors those who earn standing with the Frostwolf clan.

faq.q: What is the Proving Grounds quest?
faq.answer: Warmaster Laggrond asks prospective recruits to retrieve a Frostwolf banner from the Wildpaw Den in Alterac Valley. The trial proves their resourcefulness before they join the campaign.

faq.q: Why is the Horde fighting in Alterac Valley?
faq.answer: The Frostwolf clan claims Alterac Valley as its home after exile during the First War. The Stormpike Guard, an Alliance dwarven expedition, has pushed into the region in search of relics and territory, sparking a bitter territorial war.

faq.q: Can Alliance players interact with Warmaster Laggrond?
faq.answer: No. Warmaster Laggrond is a devoted Horde champion and attacks Alliance trespassers who approach his mountain outpost.

angles.text: Warmaster Laggrond is your first contact for the Alterac Valley war effort. He recognizes your battlefield achievements for the Frostwolf clan.
As an orc, answering Laggrond's summons means defending the Frostwolf clan's ancestral refuge from dwarven intrusion.
As a warrior, you face Laggrond's tests of frontline courage, meant to prove you can hold against heavy dwarven armor and vanguard charges.
